# Good morning everyone. - 2026-09-27 14:51

**Date** 27 Sep 2026, 14:51 · **Duration** 3 min · **Captions** 13

_Processed entirely on-device: CPU_

## Topics

- eigenvalue
- eigenvector
- determinant
- diagonalize

## Key points

- Today we will start with eigenvalues and eigenvectors. These two ideas sit at the center of linear algebra, so it is worth going slowly.
- A matrix is a linear transformation. It stretches, rotates and cheers space.
- Those vectors are the eigenvectors, and the factor they stretch by is the eigenvalue.
- To find them we solve the characteristic equation of the matrix. The determinant of a minus lambda times the identity must equal zero.
- The determinant is a single number that tells you whether the matrix squashes space flat.
- If it is zero, there is a non-trivial solution, and that is exactly what we want.

## Follow up

None mentioned.

_Generated without an LLM - install the model for better notes._

## Glossary

_Explanations in سنڌي (Sindhi)._

- **eigenvalue** — A scalar showing how much a matrix stretches a special direction (its eigenvector).
- **eigenvector** — A direction that a matrix only stretches or shrinks, without rotating it.
- **determinant** — A single number from a square matrix; zero means the matrix squashes space flat.
- **diagonalize** — Rewriting a matrix in a basis where it becomes a simple diagonal scaling.

## Transcript

**[00:00]** Good morning everyone.
> سڀئي کي صبح جو سلام.

**[00:02]** Today we will start with eigenvalues and eigenvectors. These two ideas sit at the center of linear algebra, so it is worth going slowly.
> اڄ اسان eigenvalues ۽ eigenvectors سان شروع ڪنداسين. اهي ٻه خيال سڌي الجبرا جي مرڪز ۾ آهن، تنهنڪري اهو سست هلڻ جي قابل آهي.

**[00:15]** A matrix is a linear transformation. It stretches, rotates and cheers space.
> هڪ ميٽرڪس هڪ لائينر تبديلي آهي. اهو وڌي ٿو، ڦرندو آهي ۽ خلا کي خوش ڪري ٿو.

**[00:24]** For most vectors, applying the matrix changes both direction and length.
> گهڻن ويڪٽرز لاءِ ، ميٽرڪس لاڳو ڪرڻ سان هدايت ۽ ڊيگهه ٻنهي ۾ تبديلي ٿيندي آهي.

**[00:31]** but a few special vectors only change length. Their direction is preserved.
> پر ڪجهه خاص vectors صرف ڊيگهه تبديل. سندن رخ محفوظ آهي.

**[00:39]** Those vectors are the eigenvectors, and the factor they stretch by is the eigenvalue.
> اهي vectors آهن eigenvectors، ۽ عنصر اهي eigenvalue جي ذريعي stretch آهن.

**[00:47]** To find them we solve the characteristic equation of the matrix. The determinant of a minus lambda times the identity must equal zero.
> انهن کي ڳولڻ لاءِ اسان ميٽرڪس جي خاصيت مساوات کي حل ڪيو آهي.

**[00:59]** The determinant is a single number that tells you whether the matrix squashes space flat.
> determinant هڪ واحد نمبر آهي جيڪو توهان کي ٻڌائي ٿو ته ڇا ميٽرڪس جڳهه کي فليٽ ڪري ٿو.

**[01:07]** If it is zero, there is a non-trivial solution, and that is exactly what we want.
> جيڪڏهن اهو صفر آهي، اتي هڪ غير معمولي حل آهي، ۽ اهو ئي اسان چاهيون ٿا.

**[01:15]** Symmetric matrices always have real eigenvalues. That is a useful guarantee.
> symmetric matrices هميشه حقيقي eigenvalues آهن.

**[01:23]** Once we have a full set of eigenvectors, we can diagonalize the matrix.
> هڪ ڀيرو اسان کي eigenvectors جي مڪمل سيٽ آهي، اسان کي diagonalize ڪري سگهو ٿا.

**[01:30]** Diagonalization turns a hard repeated multiplication into a simple one.
> Diagonalization هڪ سخت بار بار بار ضرب کي هڪ سادي ۾ بدلجي ٿو.

**[01:37]** We will use this next week when we look at principal component analysis.
> اسان ايندڙ هفتي هن کي استعمال ڪنداسين جڏهن اسان بنيادي جزو تجزيو تي نظر وجهون ٿا.
